⚠ DRAFT. NOT LEGAL ADVICE. DO NOT PUBLISH YET.

This draft was written to match the Kinexis offer approved on Oct 18, 2026 and to follow common industry practice (see research.md). A licensed attorney in Texas/the US must review it before it goes live at kinexisdigital.com/terms, especially §§ 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 22, 23, 24 and 25. Items in [BRACKETS] must be filled in. The owner approved the definitions and tightenings in offer-recommendations.md on Oct 18, 2026; items still marked [OWNER TO CONFIRM] (legal entity, address, tax, disputes) need the owner and attorney. Delete this box before publishing.

Effective date: [EFFECTIVE DATE] · Version: 2.0
Who we are: [LEGAL ENTITY NAME], a [ENTITY TYPE AND STATE OF FORMATION], doing business as Kinexis Digital ("Kinexis", "we", "us"). Mailing address: [ADDRESS]. We're a remote team; we are not based in Houston. Phone/text: [TEXAS BUSINESS NUMBER] · Email: hello@kinexisdigital.com · Hours: 8 am–8 pm Central, 7 days.

Key terms at a glance

(This summary is part of these Terms. If it ever conflicts with the detailed sections, the detailed sections control.)
Free preview We build a homepage preview after a 10-minute call. No card, no obligation.
Plans Website $97/mo · Lead System $197/mo · Lead System Plus (Bilingual) $297/mo · Own It $1,497 one time. Plus any applicable tax.
When you pay $0 down. Monthly plans: first charge on your launch date, then the same day each month, until you cancel. Own It: paid when you approve your preview.
Minimum Monthly plans: 3 months from your launch date, then month-to-month.
Cancel Free any time before launch. After the minimum, cancel any time by text, email or Messenger; billing stops at the end of the month you've paid for.
Price lock Your monthly plan price won't go up for 24 months from your launch date.
60-day lead guarantee Lead System and Plus: zero tracked leads in your first 60 days live → your 3rd and 4th monthly charges are waived and the minimum is dropped. Conditions in §10.2.
Texting Starts after carrier approval (typically 10–15 days); approval isn't guaranteed.
What's yours Your domain, content, reviews, lead list and Google profile, always. Site files: after 12 paid months (or $500 sooner), or from launch day on Own It.
No promises of rankings or sales Nobody can guarantee Google rankings, leads or jobs, and we don't.

1. Agreement and acceptance

1.1 These Terms, your Order Confirmation (the signup summary we send you showing your plan, price and launch details), and our Privacy Policy at [PRIVACY POLICY URL] make up the whole agreement (the "Agreement"). If your Order Confirmation and these Terms conflict, the Order Confirmation controls for that order.
1.2 You accept by signing electronically (typing your name and checking the box at signup) or by approving your preview for launch in writing (text, email or Messenger) after you've been shown these Terms. Electronic acceptance has the same effect as a signature on paper (federal E-SIGN Act; Texas Uniform Electronic Transactions Act).
1.3 You confirm that you're at least 18, that you're signing up for a business (not personal or household use), and that you're authorized to sign for the business named in your Order Confirmation ("you", "Client").
1.4 Anything a salesperson says that isn't in the Agreement doesn't bind either of us unless it's written in your Order Confirmation or an email from us.

2. Definitions

  • Launch date: the day your site goes live on your domain. It starts your billing and your minimum.
  • Billing date: your launch date's day of the month (or the last day of a shorter month).
  • Business day: Monday to Friday, 8 am–5 pm Central time, excluding US federal holidays.
  • Small edit: a change that takes us 30 minutes or less: text, photos, hours, prices, services, contact info, adding a review you've received, swapping a gallery image, or adding a small section to an existing page.
  • New page: a new page using the existing design (for example a new service or city page). A redesign, new features, e-commerce, booking systems or custom integrations are projects, quoted separately.
  • Site files: a static copy of your website's front end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images and text) that can run on ordinary web hosting. Site files don't include our software, platform accounts or automations (including our GoHighLevel workspace), form back-ends, the tracking number, or third-party items we can't transfer under their licences.
  • Tracking number: the phone number we provide and put on your website so calls can be counted and missed calls texted back.
  • Texting features: missed-call text-back and review-request texts.
  • Tracked lead: defined in §10.2.
  • Your content: anything you give us (logo, photos, text, licence numbers, customer lists), your reviews, and the leads and contacts your site collects.

3. The free preview

3.1 After a short intake call, we build a homepage preview for your business at no cost and with no obligation. We don't ask for a card. We aim to send it within 2 business days after the call.
3.2 The preview is a private link on our servers. Until you choose a plan, the preview design belongs to us. If you don't go ahead, we delete it within 30 days and don't use your name, logo or photos for anything else.
3.3 One free preview per business. We may decline to build a preview, for example for businesses we can't serve lawfully (see §18).

4. Plans and what's included

4.1 What each plan includes is listed on our offer page on the date you sign up and in your Order Confirmation. In summary:

Website Lead System Lead System Plus (Bilingual) Own It
Price $97/mo $197/mo $297/mo $1,497 one time
Pages Up to 5 Up to 10 Up to 20, English + Spanish Up to 10
Hosting, SSL, security, backups ✓ ✓ ✓ 12 months included, then optional Site Care $39/mo
Small edits Up to 2 per month, within 2 business days Unlimited, within 1 business day (§9) Unlimited, same business day if received by noon Central (§9) 12 months included, up to 30 min per month (§9)
New pages $99 each 1 per month included 2 per month included Quoted
Missed-call text-back + review requests — ✓ ✓ English + Spanish Optional add-on $97/mo
Google Business Profile — Tune-up at launch Tune-up at launch + 2 posts per month —
Tracking number + monthly report Form leads only ✓ ✓ —
60-day lead guarantee — ✓ ✓ —
Minimum 3 months 3 months 3 months None
Site files yours After 12 paid months, or $500 sooner same same From launch date

4.2 Included pages and edits that you don't use in a month don't roll over and have no cash value.
4.3 Bonuses (Lead System and Plus): if you don't have a domain, we register one in your name and pay for the first year; a printable review QR card; a simple text logo if you don't have one. Bonuses have no cash value.
4.4 Changing plans. You can upgrade any time; the new price starts on your next billing date and the 24-month price lock restarts for the new plan. Downgrading during the minimum isn't available; after the minimum it starts on your next billing date.

5. Getting started: timelines and what we need from you

5.1 Launch. We aim to launch within 7 days after (a) you approve the preview and sign up, and (b) we have what we need from you: your business details, any licence number required by law, and access to your domain (or your OK to register one). Logos and job photos help but aren't required.
5.2 Delays on your side. If we're waiting on you for more than 30 days, we'll check in; after 60 days we may close the order without charge.
5.3 Texting setup. Texting features need carrier approval of your business (A2P 10DLC registration, in your business's name). It usually takes 10–15 days after you give us accurate information, but carriers decide, and approval isn't guaranteed. Your website, tracking number and Google profile work start on your launch date regardless.
5.4 If texting is never approved. If carriers haven't approved texting within 60 days of your launch date for reasons that aren't caused by inaccurate information from you, you may cancel without owing the rest of the minimum.

6. Billing

6.1 $0 down. Nothing is charged for the preview or before your launch date.
6.2 Monthly plans are charged in advance on your launch date and then on each billing date, to the card or bank account you authorize at signup, through our payment processor (Stripe). You authorize these recurring charges until you cancel as described in §7. Charges appear on your statement as "KINEXIS DIGITAL".
6.3 Own It is charged in full when you approve your preview and sign up. Optional Site Care ($39/mo) and the texting add-on ($97/mo) are monthly plans under these Terms, without a minimum.
6.4 Taxes. Prices don't include any sales or other taxes that may apply. If tax applies, it's shown on your invoice. [ACCOUNTANT: confirm Texas data-processing tax treatment and whether Kinexis must collect]
6.5 Receipts. You'll get a receipt by email for every charge.
6.6 Failed payments. If a payment fails, we'll tell you and retry for 7 days. If it's still unpaid after 14 days, we may suspend the service: your site shows a neutral "temporarily unavailable" page and texting pauses. If it's unpaid after 30 days, we may end the service under §7.6. We don't charge late fees or interest. Amounts owed stay owed.
6.7 Billing questions and chargebacks. If you think a charge is wrong, tell us within 60 days and we'll fix real errors within 10 business days. Please contact us before disputing a charge with your bank. If you dispute a charge that wasn't in error without contacting us first, we may suspend the service while the dispute is open and recover the processor's dispute fee from you if the dispute is decided in our favor.

7. Minimum term, renewal and cancellation

7.1 Before launch: you can cancel any time before your launch date by text, email or Messenger and owe nothing.
7.2 Minimum term: monthly plans have a 3-month minimum starting on your launch date (three monthly charges).
7.3 Renewal: after the minimum, your plan continues month to month and is charged on each billing date until you cancel. There's no new contract term.
7.4 How to cancel (after the minimum): send "cancel" with your business name by text to [TEXAS BUSINESS NUMBER], by email to hello@kinexisdigital.com, or by Messenger to our Facebook Page. No phone call or form is required. We'll confirm in writing within 1 business day. If we get your request before your next billing date, you won't be charged again; your service runs to the end of the month you've paid for. No cancellation fee.
7.5 Cancelling during the minimum: you can give notice any time, but the remaining charges of the minimum are still due on their normal billing dates (or, if you prefer, at once), unless (a) the 60-day lead guarantee applies (§10.2), (b) §5.4 applies, or (c) we've materially breached the Agreement and not fixed it within 15 days of your written notice.
7.6 When we can end the service:

  • (a) for cause: non-payment under §6.6; a serious breach of §18 (for example unlawful content or misuse of texting); or abusive or threatening conduct toward our team. Where we can, we'll give you notice and 7 days to fix it first.
  • (b) without cause: with 30 days' written notice. If we do, we refund any prepaid unused period, the minimum no longer applies, and you get your site files free.
    7.7 Reminder: about 10 days before your minimum ends, we'll remind you that your plan will continue month to month and how to cancel.

8. Price lock, price changes and fair use

8.1 24-month price lock: your plan's monthly price won't increase for 24 months from your launch date. The lock covers the plan price. Taxes and optional add-ons you choose aren't part of it, and changing plans restarts the lock at the new plan's price.
8.2 After the lock: we may change prices with at least 30 days' written notice. You can cancel before the new price applies (the minimum won't apply then).
8.3 Fair use: plans are priced for normal use by one small business. Normal use is up to 2,000 text segments and 1,500 forwarded call minutes per month. If your use is consistently above that, we'll contact you to agree a solution before any extra charge; we won't add charges without your written OK.

9. Edits and support

9.1 Send edit requests by text, email or Messenger. Turnaround starts once we have everything needed (the wording, photos or details).
9.2 Turnaround: Website plan within 2 business days (up to 2 small edits per month); Lead System within 1 business day; Plus the same business day if received by noon Central, otherwise the next business day.
9.3 "Unlimited" small edits means there's no monthly count. We handle requests one at a time in the order received, and a batch of many changes sent together may take more than one turnaround period. Work over 30 minutes counts as a new page (if it is one) or a project, and we'll quote it before starting.
9.4 Own It: small edits for the first 12 months, up to 30 minutes per month in total, done within 2 business days. Unused time doesn't roll over. After that, Site Care ($39/mo) includes up to 30 minutes per month.
9.5 Projects and extra pages are quoted in writing; nothing is charged without your OK.

10. Our guarantees

10.1 Preview guarantee.

If you don't love your preview, you owe nothing.

10.2 60-day lead guarantee (Lead System and Plus only)

  • The promise: if your site gets zero tracked leads in the first 60 days after your launch date, we will (a) waive your 3rd and 4th monthly charges (or refund the 3rd if it's already been charged), and (b) drop the rest of your minimum, so you can cancel at any time with nothing more owed.
  • A "tracked lead" is:
    • (a) a call to the tracking number shown on your website that lasts 30 seconds or more; or
    • (b) a missed call to that number where the caller replies to the automatic text; or
    • (c) a quote or contact form sent from your website with a real name and a working phone number or email.
  • These don't count: calls, texts or forms from you, your staff, family or Kinexis; spam, robocalls and bots; sales pitches and job seekers; and repeat contacts from the same person or number (each person counts once).
  • Conditions:
    • (1) your site stayed live on your domain with our tracking number and forms in place, and you didn't remove, replace or hide them;
    • (2) your account was paid up;
    • (3) any days the site was down or changed because of you (for example DNS or domain changes, removing the number, or suspension for non-payment) extend the 60 days by the same number of days;
    • (4) the guarantee applies once per business and owner.
  • How it works: we'll send you the call and form log at day 60. If it shows zero tracked leads, the guarantee applies automatically. If you think we've miscounted, tell us within 30 days after day 60; we'll review the log with you, and the log from our call-tracking and form systems decides.
  • What it is not: a promise of any number of leads, jobs, sales or Google rankings. Results depend on your market, your services, your reviews, your prices and how fast you answer.
  • The guarantee is a credit and release, not a cash payment (except refunding the 3rd charge if it was already taken), and it can't be combined with other discounts on the same months.

10.3 Launch-timing promise.

If we miss the 7-day launch target in §5.1 for reasons on our side, your first monthly charge is waived. Delays waiting on you, your domain registrar, Google or carriers don't count.

11. Texting, calls and your customers

11.1 What we send: missed-call text-back sends one informational reply to a person who just called your tracking number and wasn't answered. Review requests go only to your customers that you give us, after a job.
11.2 Your promise: you confirm that every customer you give us for review requests has given you permission to contact them by text and/or email about their job, and you'll tell us right away about anyone who asks not to be contacted. A simple line on your estimate or invoice works ("By giving us your mobile number, you agree to receive texts about your job, including a review request. Reply STOP to opt out."). [ATTORNEY: confirm consent language under TCPA and Texas Bus. & Com. Code chs. 302/304]
11.3 How messages are sent: every text names your business, honors STOP and any other reasonable opt-out request, and is sent only between 9 am and 8 pm in the recipient's local time (noon to 8 pm on Sundays). We don't add promotions to text-back messages, and we don't send marketing blasts under any plan. Any future marketing texts would need a separate written agreement and proof of consent.
11.4 Registration: we register your business for A2P 10DLC texting in your business's name. You agree to give accurate information (legal name, EIN, address, website) and to cooperate with carrier requests.
11.5 Call recording: we don't record calls unless you ask in writing. If you do, a recording notice plays at the start of each call, and you're responsible for any consent needed where your callers are.
11.6 Carrier and platform fees are included in your plan price within fair use (§8.3).

12. Reviews

12.1 We ask every customer you give us for an honest review. We never filter out, "gate" or redirect unhappy customers, offer rewards tied to positive reviews, write or buy reviews, or post reviews from you, your staff or family without a clear disclosure. If a customer shares a complaint with us, we pass it to you right away, and they remain free to post publicly.
12.2 You agree not to ask us to do any of the above, and not to use threats or unfounded legal claims to remove honest reviews. (FTC rule on consumer reviews, 16 CFR Part 465; FTC guidance on soliciting reviews; Google's review policies.)

13. Google Business Profile

13.1 You stay the owner of your Google Business Profile. We ask only for manager access and remove ourselves when you leave.
13.2 Google decides what appears on Google, including suspensions, verification and rankings. We'll help you respond to problems but can't control Google's decisions.

14. Domain names

14.1 Your domain is registered in your name as registrant. If we register it for you, we transfer full control to you within 5 business days of a request, at no charge, at any time, subject to registrar locks under ICANN's Transfer Policy (which can delay a transfer to a new registrar after a recent registration or transfer).
14.2 Renewals. If we registered the domain for you, renewals are included at no charge while you're on a Website, Lead System or Plus plan. On Own It, the first year is included and later renewals are billed to you at our cost (about $11–20/yr depending on the extension), or you can move the domain to your own registrar account. After you leave that plan, renewals are your responsibility.

15. Ownership and licences

15.1 Your content is yours. You give us a non-exclusive licence to use your content only to provide the services while the Agreement is active and for the wind-down in §17.
15.2 Site files: on Own It, yours from your launch date (on full payment). On monthly plans, yours free after 12 paid monthly charges, or any time before that for $500. Until then, Kinexis owns the design and code and licenses them to you while your plan is active. "Yours" means we assign our copyright in the site files to you; third-party components remain under their own licences.
15.3 Our tools stay ours. Our software, templates in general form, know-how, automations and platform accounts remain Kinexis's (or our providers').
15.4 Third-party items: stock photos, fonts and plug-ins we provide are licensed to you on their own terms (for example, the Unsplash License). We only use items we're allowed to use.
15.5 Portfolio: we may show your live site (name, screenshots, link) in our portfolio and ads. You can opt out any time by telling us, and we'll stop using it in new materials within 10 business days.

16. Tracking number

16.1 The tracking number is provided through our phone provider and isn't owned by you. While your plan is active it rings the phone number you choose.
16.2 When you leave, we forward it to your phone for 30 days at no charge. If you'd like to keep it, we'll help with a port request where the provider allows. [CONFIRM with GoHighLevel/LC Phone whether numbers can be ported out]

17. What happens when you leave

At the end of your last paid month:

  • If the site files are yours (12+ paid months, bought, or Own It): we send you the site files and help point your domain wherever you choose.
  • If they're not: the site comes down and your domain stays yours. Within 10 business days of a request, we export your content: your text, photos, logo, reviews you've given us, and your lead/contact list (CSV).
  • Texting features stop. The tracking number forwards for 30 days (§16.2). We remove our access to your Google profile and domain.
  • We delete your data from our tools 90 days after you leave, unless you ask sooner or the law requires us to keep it.

18. Your responsibilities and acceptable use

18.1 You'll give us accurate information and promptly tell us when it changes.
18.2 You're responsible for the claims about your own business on your site: licences, insurance, warranties, years in business, prices, service areas and reviews. You confirm you hold every licence your work requires. Texas plumbing and HVAC (ACR) contractors must give us their licence number, and we show it on the site as Texas rules require.
18.3 You'll only give us content you have the right to use.
18.4 You won't use the services for: work you're not licensed to do; false, misleading or defamatory content; content that infringes others' rights; spam or texts to people who haven't agreed to receive them; illegal products or services; or harassment. We may remove content that breaks this section and will tell you why.
18.5 You'll keep your logins secure and tell us about any unauthorized access.

19. Hosting, uptime, security and accessibility

19.1 We use reasonable care to keep your site online, secure and backed up, and we fix problems promptly. We don't guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service: hosting providers, the internet, carriers and Google can fail or change.
19.2 We build sites following common accessibility practices and will fix accessibility issues you report as small edits or projects. We don't certify that a site meets any particular accessibility standard or law.

20. No guarantee of rankings or results; third-party services

20.1 We don't promise Google rankings, map-pack placement, a number of calls, leads, jobs or revenue. The only results-based promise we make is the 60-day lead guarantee in §10.2, with its limited remedy.
20.2 Parts of the service depend on companies we don't control: Google, Meta, phone carriers and the A2P registry, our hosting, phone and messaging providers (including GoHighLevel/LeadConnector), domain registrars and Stripe. We're not responsible for their outages, policy changes or decisions, but we'll work to minimize the effect on you.

21. Refunds

21.1 Monthly fees already paid aren't refundable, except under §10.2 (guarantee), §7.6(b) (if we end the service), or for our billing errors, or where the law requires.
21.2 Own It: if we don't launch within 30 days of your approval for reasons on our side, you can cancel for a full refund. After launch, Own It isn't refundable. [ATTORNEY to review]

22. Privacy and your customers' data

22.1 Our Privacy Policy at [PRIVACY POLICY URL] explains how we handle information about you.
22.2 For information about your customers (calls, texts, form submissions, review recipients), we act as your service provider: we use it only to provide the services to you, keep it confidential, protect it with reasonable security, and don't sell it. We'll add a basic privacy notice to your website describing the forms, call tracking and texting.

23. Warranties and disclaimers

23.1 We'll perform the services with reasonable skill and care, consistent with these Terms.
23.2 Except as stated in these Terms, and to the extent the law allows, the services are provided "as is", and we disclaim implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. This doesn't limit any rights you have that can't be waived by law, including under the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices-Consumer Protection Act. [ATTORNEY: confirm DTPA interaction]

24. Limitation of liability

24.1 To the extent the law allows, neither of us is liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, or for lost profits, revenue, jobs or data, even if advised they were possible.
24.2 To the extent the law allows, our total liability for all claims under the Agreement is limited to the fees you paid us in the 3 months before the event giving rise to the claim.
24.3 These limits don't apply to fraud, wilful misconduct, or your obligation to pay fees owed. [ATTORNEY: confirm cap and Texas conspicuousness requirements]

25. Indemnification

25.1 You'll defend and indemnify Kinexis against third-party claims arising from: your content; your licences or the claims you make about your business; texts or emails sent to contacts you gave us without the consent required by law; or the work you perform for your customers.
25.2 We'll defend and indemnify you against third-party claims that the design or code we created for your site (not your content or third-party components) infringes their copyright.
25.3 The indemnified party must promptly notify the other, let them control the defense, and cooperate. [ATTORNEY: Texas fair-notice/express-negligence requirements]

26. Disputes

26.1 Talk first: before filing anything, send the other party a written description of the problem, and give 30 days to try to resolve it.
26.2 Governing law: Texas law governs the Agreement, without regard to conflict-of-laws rules. [OWNER TO CONFIRM + ATTORNEY]
26.3 Where: the state or federal courts in Harris County, Texas, except that either of us may bring a claim in a Texas justice court (small claims) with jurisdiction. [ATTORNEY: decide whether to add individual arbitration instead]
26.4 WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL AND CLASS ACTIONS. TO THE EXTENT THE LAW ALLOWS, YOU AND KINEXIS EACH WAIVE THE RIGHT TO A JURY TRIAL AND AGREE TO BRING CLAIMS ONLY ON AN INDIVIDUAL BASIS, NOT AS A PLAINTIFF OR CLASS MEMBER IN ANY CLASS OR REPRESENTATIVE PROCEEDING. [ATTORNEY: confirm enforceability and formatting]

27. Changes to these Terms

We'll give you at least 30 days' notice of changes by email or text. Changes can't raise your price during your price lock, and they don't apply to a dispute that arose before the change. If a change materially reduces your rights or the services, you may cancel before it takes effect without owing the rest of your minimum.

28. Notices and communications

28.1 We'll send notices to the email and mobile number in your Order Confirmation. You can send notices to hello@kinexisdigital.com or by text to [TEXAS BUSINESS NUMBER].
28.2 You agree we may contact you by call, text or email about your account, your site and service updates. Marketing messages from us are optional; reply STOP to opt out of texts.

29. General

29.1 Independent parties: we're independent contractors; neither of us is the other's agent.
29.2 Assignment: you may transfer the Agreement with our written OK (we won't unreasonably refuse, for example if you sell your business). We may transfer it to a successor business with notice to you.
29.3 Force majeure: neither of us is liable for delays caused by events beyond reasonable control, such as natural disasters, widespread outages, carrier or platform failures, or government action. Payment obligations for services actually provided continue.
29.4 Severability: if a part of the Agreement is unenforceable, the rest still applies.
29.5 Survival: §§ 6 (amounts owed), 15, 17, 22–26 and 29 survive the end of the Agreement.
29.6 No waiver: not enforcing a right right away doesn't waive it.
29.7 Language: we may provide these Terms in Spanish for convenience. If the English and Spanish versions differ, the English version controls.

30. Contact

Kinexis Digital · [LEGAL ENTITY NAME] · [ADDRESS] · [TEXAS BUSINESS NUMBER] · hello@kinexisdigital.com

Lo esencial

(Este resumen forma parte de los Términos. Si contradice las secciones detalladas, prevalecen las secciones detalladas.)
Vista previa gratis Hacemos una vista previa de su página principal después de una llamada de 10 minutos. Sin tarjeta y sin compromiso.
Planes Página Web $97/mes · Sistema de Clientes $197/mes · Sistema de Clientes Plus (Bilingüe) $297/mes · Suya $1,497 un solo pago. Más impuestos, si aplican.
Cuándo paga $0 de entrada. Planes mensuales: el primer cobro es el día que se publica su página, y luego el mismo día cada mes, hasta que cancele. Plan Suya: se paga al aprobar la vista previa.
Mínimo Planes mensuales: 3 meses desde que se publica la página, y luego mes a mes.
Cancelar Gratis en cualquier momento antes de publicar. Después del mínimo, cancele cuando quiera por texto, correo o Messenger; el cobro se detiene al final del mes ya pagado.
Precio congelado Su mensualidad no sube durante 24 meses desde que se publica la página.
Garantía de 60 días Sistema de Clientes y Plus: si no recibe ningún contacto registrado en sus primeros 60 días publicada, le perdonamos el 3.º y 4.º cobro mensual y se elimina el mínimo. Condiciones en la §10.2.

  • Archivos del sitio: una copia estática de la parte visible de su sitio (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imágenes y textos) que funciona en un hosting normal. No incluyen nuestro software, cuentas de plataforma ni automatizaciones (incluido nuestro espacio de GoHighLevel), el sistema detrás de los formularios, el número de seguimiento ni elementos de terceros que no podamos transferir según sus licencias.

23. Garantías legales y exclusiones

23.1 Prestaremos los servicios con habilidad y cuidado razonables, de acuerdo con estos Términos.
23.2 Salvo lo indicado en estos Términos, y en la medida que la ley lo permita, los servicios se prestan "tal como están", y excluimos las garantías implícitas de comerciabilidad, idoneidad para un fin particular y no infracción. Esto no limita los derechos que la ley no permite renunciar, incluidos los de la Ley de Prácticas Comerciales Engañosas y Protección al Consumidor de Texas (DTPA). [ABOGADO: confirmar relación con la DTPA]

24. Límite de responsabilidad

24.1 En la medida que la ley lo permita, ninguna de las partes responde por daños indirectos, incidentales, especiales o consecuentes, ni por pérdida de ganancias, ingresos, trabajos o datos, aunque se haya advertido de esa posibilidad.
24.2 En la medida que la ley lo permita, nuestra responsabilidad total por todos los reclamos bajo el Acuerdo se limita a lo que usted nos pagó en los 3 meses anteriores al hecho que dio origen al reclamo.
24.3 Estos límites no aplican en caso de fraude, conducta dolosa, ni a su obligación de pagar lo que deba. [ABOGADO: confirmar el límite y los requisitos de visibilidad en Texas]

25. Indemnización

25.1 Usted defenderá e indemnizará a Kinexis frente a reclamos de terceros que surjan de: su contenido; sus licencias o lo que usted afirma sobre su negocio; textos o correos enviados a contactos que usted nos dio sin el consentimiento que exige la ley; o los trabajos que usted hace para sus clientes.
25.2 Nosotros lo defenderemos e indemnizaremos frente a reclamos de terceros de que el diseño o el código que nosotros creamos para su sitio (no su contenido ni componentes de terceros) viola sus derechos de autor.
25.3 La parte indemnizada debe avisar pronto a la otra, dejarle controlar la defensa y cooperar. [ABOGADO: requisitos de aviso claro en Texas]

26. Disputas

26.1 Primero hablar: antes de presentar cualquier reclamo, envíe a la otra parte una descripción por escrito del problema y dé 30 días para intentar resolverlo.
26.2 Ley aplicable: el Acuerdo se rige por las leyes de Texas, sin aplicar sus reglas de conflicto de leyes. [POR CONFIRMAR POR EL DUEÑO + ABOGADO]
26.3 Dónde: los tribunales estatales o federales del Condado de Harris, Texas, aunque cualquiera de las partes puede presentar un reclamo ante un tribunal de justicia de paz de Texas (reclamos menores) competente. [ABOGADO: decidir si se agrega arbitraje individual]
26.4 RENUNCIA A JUICIO CON JURADO Y A DEMANDAS COLECTIVAS. EN LA MEDIDA QUE LA LEY LO PERMITA, USTED Y KINEXIS RENUNCIAN AL DERECHO A UN JUICIO CON JURADO Y ACEPTAN PRESENTAR RECLAMOS SOLO DE FORMA INDIVIDUAL, NO COMO DEMANDANTE NI MIEMBRO DE UNA DEMANDA COLECTIVA O REPRESENTATIVA. [ABOGADO: confirmar validez y formato]

27. Cambios a estos Términos

Le daremos al menos 30 días de aviso de cualquier cambio por correo o texto. Los cambios no pueden subir su precio durante el plazo de precio congelado, y no aplican a una disputa que haya surgido antes del cambio. Si un cambio reduce de forma importante sus derechos o los servicios, puede cancelar antes de que entre en vigor sin pagar el resto del mínimo.

28. Avisos y comunicaciones

28.1 Enviaremos los avisos al correo y celular de su Confirmación de Orden. Usted puede enviar avisos a hello@kinexisdigital.com o por texto al [NÚMERO DE TEXAS].
28.2 Usted acepta que lo contactemos por llamada, texto o correo sobre su cuenta, su sitio y novedades del servicio. Los mensajes publicitarios nuestros son opcionales; responda STOP para no recibir más textos.

29. Disposiciones generales

29.1 Partes independientes: somos contratistas independientes; ninguna parte es agente de la otra.
29.2 Cesión: usted puede transferir el Acuerdo con nuestra autorización por escrito (no la negaremos sin razón, por ejemplo si vende su negocio). Nosotros podemos transferirlo a un negocio sucesor avisándole.
29.3 Fuerza mayor: ninguna parte responde por demoras causadas por hechos fuera de su control razonable, como desastres naturales, caídas generalizadas, fallas de compañías telefónicas o plataformas, o actos de gobierno. Las obligaciones de pago por servicios efectivamente prestados continúan.
29.4 Divisibilidad: si una parte del Acuerdo no se puede hacer cumplir, el resto sigue vigente.
29.5 Vigencia posterior: las §§ 6 (montos adeudados), 15, 17, 22–26 y 29 siguen vigentes después de terminado el Acuerdo.
29.6 Sin renuncia: no ejercer un derecho de inmediato no significa renunciar a él.
29.7 Idioma: podemos ofrecer estos Términos en español por cortesía. Si la versión en inglés y la versión en español no coinciden, prevalece la versión en inglés.
